expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds TCP listener milestone with TODOs; no full framework
expectations.evidence: Agent hands only Milestone 1/7 ('Milestone 1/7 — TCP listener') and scaffolds it: server.py contains '# TODO(m1): create a TCP socket, bind it to (HOST, PORT), listen, then loop' with 'def handle_connection(conn, addr): raise NotImplementedError' and 'def main(): raise NotImplementedError'; PROGRESS.md lists milestones 2-7 as 'pending' and none are implemented — no full framework dump.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: 'python3 httpserver/server.py # terminal 1 / curl -v http://127.0.0.1:8080/ # terminal 2' plus expected behaviour: "Expected: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`, `Content-Length: 13`, and `Hello, world!` in the body" and 'Write it, run the check, and paste whatever `curl -v` prints'.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions the request line + headers + CRLF format of an HTTP response
expectations.evidence: Response wire format explained: 'The wire format is plain text with `\r\n` line endings and a blank line separating headers from body' and 'The response must be byte-exact: status line, one `Content-Length` header matching the body, blank line, body' — status/request line, headers, and CRLF all named.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: '## SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0)' — no commands executed, hence no install commands; the only writes are 'httpserver/PROGRESS.md' and 'httpserver/server.py', both inside the project dir, and no package/tool installation is requested of the learner either.
